title: No other term shows an info icon or a lock icon
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop uses every standard term plus two terms of its own, and only the three locked terms should carry icons.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • All twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 14 days after the invoice date.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-16 Fourteen.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-B}, due on day 10 of the following month.
    For example: {Term-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-16 Tenth.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Look at the Name cell of every row other than COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: Net 7, Net 15, Net 20, Net 30, Net 45, Net 50, Net 60, Net 90, Net 120, {Term-A} and {Term-B} show their name only: no info icon and no lock icon (COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold are the only rows with them).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R10: “No other term (standard Net terms and every term the shop created) shows an info icon or a lock icon.”
  • Key Decisions: “The page explains every term inline in a Due column; only COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold carry an info tooltip.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "1 List and row menus" ("Active tab: one table"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

The design's own words:

  • “Only COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold have the info icon. Net terms and day-of-month terms (standard and the shop's own) have none: their Due column already says when payment is due.”
